body: American Airlines is considering absorbing Philadelphia International Airport (PHL)'s A West Admirals Club into its Flagship Lounge as soon as March next year, a move that could nearly double the Flagship space. The current Flagship lounge covers 12,500 square feet with capacity for 200 guests, while the neighboring A West Admirals Club covers 11,000 square feet with capacity for up to 181 guests. Merged, the two connected lounges would form a 25,000-square-foot complex.

The airline has confirmed publicly that no lounge plans are final, and the proposed expansion could be completed by spring to prepare for the summer peak. The consideration is aimed at overcrowding during Philadelphia's transatlantic departure bank, when American boosts its European schedule and thousands more weekly passengers pass through the airport. If the takeover proceeds, premium travelers would gain additional Flagship seating, while Admirals Club members using the A West lounge would need to walk farther to the Admirals Club in terminals B and C. Philadelphia is an important base for American, with more than 300 flights recorded daily.
en.summary: American Airlines is considering merging Philadelphia's A West Admirals Club into its Flagship Lounge as soon as March, which could nearly double Flagship space to 25,000 square feet, though the airline says no plans are final.
en.title: American Airlines considers nearly doubling Philadelphia Flagship Lounge

body: 美國航空正在考慮最快明年3月將費城國際機場西側頭等艙貴賓室併入旗艦貴賓室，此舉可能使旗艦貴賓室空間幾乎翻倍。目前的旗艦貴賓室面積為12500平方英尺，可容納200名旅客，鄰近的西側頭等艙貴賓室面積為11000平方英尺，最多可容納181名旅客；兩間相連的貴賓室合併後，將形成25000平方英尺的綜合空間。
美國航空已公開確認，目前沒有任何貴賓室計畫定案，擬議的擴張可能在春季前完成，以因應夏季旺季。考慮合併的原因是費城跨大西洋出發時段的擁擠問題，夏季美國航空增加歐洲航線，每週有數千名旅客通過機場。若合併案成行，尊榮旅客將獲得更多旗艦貴賓室座位，而目前使用西側頭等艙貴賓室的會員則需步行更遠，前往位於B航廈與C航廈的頭等艙貴賓室。費城是美國航空的重要基地，每日有300多班航班。
zh.summary: 美國航空考慮最快明年3月將費城西側頭等艙貴賓室併入旗艦貴賓室，空間可能幾乎翻倍至25000平方英尺，但航空公司表示目前沒有任何計畫定案。
zh.title: 美國航空考慮將費城旗艦貴賓室擴大近一倍
